options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

These goals also determine how many level ups are placed in the pool-

Kill Inquisitor Wwargaz: Level Cap 8 - goal is to kill Inquisitor Wwargaz in the Creche.
    The space laser does not count.
Act 1 user defined fights: Level Cap 8 - goal is to defeat selected bosses (see UserDefinedFights).
Kill Myrkul: Level Cap 10 - goal is to kill the Avatar of Myrkul at the end of Act 2.
Act 2 user defined fights: Level Cap 10 - goal is to defeat selected bosses (see UserDefinedFights).
Kill the Nether Brain: Level Cap 12 - goal is to kill the Nether Brain at the end of Act 3. UNTESTED.
Act 3 user defined fights: Level Cap 12 - goal is to defeat selected bosses (see UserDefinedFights). UNTESTED.

(Note: l'équilibre de progression est recommandé à 0)
Détermine ce qui compte pour la victoire.
Ces objectifs déterminent également combien de niveaux sont placés dans le bassin- Rescue Halsin: Niveau Cap 5 - le but est de sauver Halsin et de le rendre en toute sécurité à la Grove.
Kill Inquisitor Wwargaz: Niveau Cap 8 - but est de tuer l'Inquisiteur Wwargaz dans la Creche.
    Le laser spatial ne compte pas.
Acte 1 combat défini par l'utilisateur : Niveau Cap 8 - but est de vaincre les patrons sélectionnés (voir UserDefinedFights).
Kill Myrkul: Niveau Cap 10 - but est de tuer l'Avatar de Myrkul à la fin de l'Acte 2.

options.name: Killsanity
options.doc:
Whether kills of individual creatures should be locations.
Kills do _not_ count if they are done by falling damage or by being thrown into a chasm.

Currently the only option is "All Nonmissable Hostiles" -  The intent was all monsters that are either default or story-forced hostile,
and are not likely to be missed by advancing plot. There still do exist some fights that are technically missable (paladins, Nere, etc), but
only by transitions that have explicit warnings on them.

Nonmissable Hostiles Location count - Halsin: 151, Wwargaz: 282, Myrkul: 522, Netherbrain: 971

options.name: Killsanity Strictness
options.doc:
If Killsanity is on, determines how strict the requirements are for a kill to count as a location.
Strict: Only kills by player characters count.
Normal: Only kills count. This is the default.
Relaxed: As long as they die, it counts.
options.doc_fr:
Si Killsanity est sur, détermine à quel point les exigences pour un meurtre sont strictes pour compter comme un emplacement.
Strict: Seulement tue par les personnages de joueur comptent.
Normal: Il ne fait que tuer. C'est par défaut.
Relaxed: Tant qu'ils meurent, ça compte.

options.name: Questsanity
options.doc:
Whether quest updates should be locations.
Some locations may be buggy or missable- please tell the BG3 channel if any quest doesn't complete that you think should've.
Due to the nature of the branching of BG3 paths, many quests had to have choices as to what options were viable.
Currently the only option is "Most Content" - skill checks are not expected to be passed _unless_ future content depends on it.

Most Content Location count - Halsin: 178, Wwargaz: 281, Myrkul: 346, Netherbrain: 559

options.name: Containersanity
options.doc:
Whether opening containers should be locations. It turns every
openable container placed in a Prologue/Act 1-3 level into a check.
Caveats/Disclaimers:
Locations that require stealing are limited in Act 1, but relaxed in Act 2+3.
Destroying a container also sends the check.
Not all containers are locations - some are bugged or broken or inaccessible.

Containersanity location count - Halsin: 1773, Wwargaz: 2683, Myrkul: 5245, Netherbrain: 10575

options.name: Container Highlight
options.doc:
Highlights containers in the world so you can find them. This is rather disruptive so is only
recommended if you are using Containersanity. Additionally, many containers will be highlighted
that are not actually locations - some are unreachable or bugged or whatever. The highlight
only knows whether things "could" be locations.
options.doc_fr: Points forts conteneurs dans le monde pour que vous puissiez les trouver. C'est plutôt perturbateur donc est seulement recommandé si vous utilisez Containersanity. De plus, de nombreux conteneurs seront mis en évidence qui ne sont pas réellement des emplacements - certains sont inaccessibles ou boguent ou quoi que ce soit. Le point culminant sait seulement si les choses « pourraient » être des endroits.

options.name: Statsanity
options.doc:
Whether stats should be items. Currently unimplemented. If selected, all characters start at all stats at 8 and you must
get stats from the multiworld. This is currently only in testing.
Tav only stats: Only Tav's stats are randomized, and the companions' stats are left alone.
Party slots: Stats are only applied to party slots, and not the characters. Rearranging the party will rearrange stats.
Universal stats: Stats are not character specific, and all characters get the same stat boosts when a stat item is received.
Character stats: Stats are character specific, and each character's stats are randomized separately.

options.name: Statsanity Boost By
options.doc:
If Statsanity is on, determines how much each stat item boosts the stat by.
Halsin requires stats at 12, Wwargaz requires stats at 16, Myrkul requires stats at 20.
The number of item slots taken will be characters * 6 * (required_stat - 8) / boost_amount, 
so for example if boost_amount is 2, goal is Myrkul, and party_slots is chosen,
the number of items taken will be 4*6*6 = 144 (this is the highest option).
Even numbers only, please.
options.doc_fr:
Si Statsanity est activé, déterminez la quantité de chaque élément de la statistique booste la statistique par.
Halsin nécessite des statistiques à 12, Wwargaz nécessite des statistiques à 16, Myrkul nécessite des statistiques à 20.
Le nombre de fentes d'article prises sera de caractères * 6 * (required stat - 8) / boost amount, par exemple si boost amount est 2, but est Myrkul, et parti slots est choisi, le nombre d'éléments pris sera 4*6*6 = 144 (c'est l'option la plus élevée).
Même les chiffres, s'il vous plaît.

options.name: Characters in Logic
options.doc:
Which characters the generator should assume you will recruit.
A character NOT listed here has their character-specific plot events removed from the
location pool: locations named "<Character>: ..." and any "Recruit <Character>" location
(e.g. removing Lae'zel drops "Lae'zel: Deal with Patrol" and "Beach-LZ: Recruit Lae'zel").
If Questsanity is on, determines which characters' quest completions are included in logic.
Currently in testing - not considered stable. In particular Halsin seems required through act 2.

options.name: Deathlink
options.doc: If true, when a player dies, all players receive an item that kills them. Currently in testing.
options.doc_fr: Si vrai, quand un joueur meurt, tous les joueurs reçoivent un élément qui les tue. Actuellement en test.

options.name: Deathlink Consequence
options.doc:
If Deathlink is on, determines what happens when a player receives a deathlink.
Kill: The player dies immediately.
Knockout: The player is knocked out.
options.doc_fr:
Si Deathlink est activé, détermine ce qui se passe quand un joueur reçoit un lien de mort.
Kill: Le joueur meurt immédiatement.
Knockout: Le joueur est frappé.

options.name: SyncMethod
options.doc:
Determines how AP items will be delivered into BG3.
With a current mod and client, items are delivered automatically within about a second regardless
of this choice, and the AP Sync scroll remains as a manual "force a sync now" button.
This option only changes behavior with an OLD mod version (no sync timer):
Scroll_Tav - Items will only be generated when the scroll is cast, and placed in Tav's inventory.
Any_action_Tav - Items will be generated when ANYBODY takes ANY action that the game considers worth triggering the listener flag for
    (which is most things).
options.doc_fr:
Détermine la façon dont les articles PA seront livrés dans BG3.
Avec un mod actuel et un client, les éléments sont livrés automatiquement dans environ une seconde, indépendamment de ce choix, et le défilement AP Sync reste comme un bouton manuel "forcez une synchronisation maintenant".
Cette option ne modifie le comportement qu'avec une version OLD mod (pas de chronomètre de synchronisation):
Scroll Tav - Les éléments ne seront générés que lorsque le défilement sera lancé et placé dans l'inventaire de Tav.
Any action Tav - Les éléments seront générés lorsque N'IMPORTE UNE action que le jeu considère utile de déclencher le drapeau de l'auditeur (qui est la plupart des choses).

options.name: Trim Treasure Method
options.doc:
The standard method of having 1:1 items:locations does not work for BG3. Each option instead lists how many locations or items they add.
Locations are filled with progression first, then useful, and if there is room left, filler.
If there are not enough locations for all of the useful items, they will be trimmed. This option determines how this trimming is done.
- Remove Later Treasure First: Removes treasure items that are found later in the game first. This is the recommended option for a more balanced playthrough.
- Remove Random Treasure: Removes treasure items at random.

options.name: Additional Level Fragments
options.doc:
For an easier play through, this adds items to support additional levels into the pool. Not recommended.
Each level up requires 4 fragments, so if you add 40 fragments, there will be 10 additional level ups available.
Logic does not account for these- you are still expected to be able to clear the locations at the expected levels.
options.doc_fr:
Pour un jeu plus facile, cela ajoute des éléments pour soutenir des niveaux supplémentaires dans le bassin. Non recommandé.
Chaque niveau supérieur nécessite 4 fragments, donc si vous ajoutez 40 fragments, il y aura 10 niveaux supplémentaires disponibles.
Logic ne tient pas compte de ces - on s'attend toujours à ce que vous soyez en mesure d'éliminer les emplacements aux niveaux prévus.

being shuffled into the multiworld.
Useful with large location counts (containersanity especially), which would otherwise
flood every other player's pool with BG3 lockpicks and healing potions.
Items named in local_items or non_local_items are left alone. Does nothing in a
single player game.

options.name: Randomize Companion Classes
options.doc:
If true, each recruitable companion starts at a random class and subclass instead of their
usual one (Lae'zel the Wizard, Karlach the Bard, ...). Applied when they are first recruited;
only level 1 is built for you, later levels are yours to pick. Your own character is never
changed.

Seul le niveau 1 est construit pour vous, les niveaux ultérieurs sont à vous de choisir. Votre propre personnage n'a jamais changé.

options.name: Randomize Companion Clothes
options.doc:
If true, each recruitable companion wears another companion's camp clothes, shoes and
underwear, applied when they are first recruited. Your own character is never changed.
options.doc_fr: Si c'est vrai, chaque compagnon recrutable porte les vêtements de camp, les chaussures et les sous-vêtements d'un autre compagnon, appliqués lors de leur premier recrutement. Votre propre personnage n'a jamais changé.
